items.title: Israeli strikes kill 16 in Lebanon hours after ceasefire
items.description: Israeli strikes in Lebanon killed at least 16 people on Saturday, hours after a ceasefire with Hezbollah took effect, with Israel saying it was responding to projectiles fired by the Iran-backed group.

items.title: Fuel excise discount extended, but prices could see small jump
items.description: The federal government is winding back its discount to the fuel excise over the next month as the 32 cents per litre fuel discount will drop to 16 cents.

items.title: Why this Paraguay star was red-carded for covering his mouth
items.description: Paraguay's Miguel Almirón fell victim to new laws put in place at this World Cup to counter discriminatory behaviour. So what are the new laws in place?

items.title: Crichton's golden point match-winner trumps Fozball in extra time
items.description: A Stephen Crichton field goal in golden point has delivered Canterbury a crucial upset win over Manly to keep their finals hopes alive.

items.title: Port star goes from equalling AFL record to facing long injury layoff
items.description: Port Adelaide defender Esava Ratugolea faces a lengthy stint on the sideline after being stretchered off with a suspected ruptured patellar tendon during the Power's 27-point loss to Collingwood on Saturday night.

items.title: Steve Irwin 'wouldn't have wanted this': Australia Zoo calls police on traditional owner
items.description: Traditional owner Alwyn Lyall says he felt "extremely upset and humiliated" when police asked him to leave Australia Zoo, where he was trying to see a crocodile he says was "wrongfully arrested" and taken from the wild.

items.title: Could the 'bliss' trade set millions up for a comfortable retirement?
items.description: Does "bliss" — big lasting state support for financial entities deemed too big to fail — make the stock market a one-way bet?

items.title: Melbourne woman suffers acute liver failure after using knock-off drug
items.description: Megan Hancocks bought a drug labelled as the peptide compound retatrutide in cash from a beautician. Within a week of her second dose, she was in acute liver failure.

items.title: Twin brothers born deaf hear their mum's voice for first time after epic surgery
items.description: An Australian-first eight hour surgical feat had one main purpose — for Artie and Jack to hear their mum's voice at the same time.

items.title: 'Everything's just so wrong': Inside the country town that turned to One Nation
items.description: In just a few short weeks, a small country town became One Nation heartland. It is a blueprint for how the party can turn Australia orange.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
